problem: Existence of three mutually orthogonal Latin squares of order 10 / OA(100,5,10,2)

acceptance.yes: One independently verified full 10x10x3 Latin witness with 100 distinct ordered pairs in AB, AC and BC overlays.
acceptance.no: One unrestricted mathematically sound nonexistence proof, or exact symmetry-complete coverage with independently checked UNSAT certificates for every remaining branch; any added cut has independent soundness evidence.
acceptance.unknown: Any timeout, unfinished branch, unsupported theorem assumption, local fixed-pair exclusion, near triple, LP relaxation, or solver result without proper checking.
